project_type: Python FastAPI backend - NEXUS AI Company Operating System
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, asyncio_mode=auto, tests in tests/ directory
verification_instructions: Run pytest to verify all existing and new tests pass
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Do NOT modify dashboard/frontend. Python 3.12+ required.
contribution_requirements: All code needs docstrings, type hints, ruff compliant, 100 char line limit, backward compatible
key_patterns: Tests use pytest fixtures, AsyncMock for DB sessions, _run() helper for sync test wrappers. Adapters extend BaseAdapter with _do_execute/_do_create_session/_do_heartbeat/_do_terminate hooks. Tests in tests/test_*.py files. Dataclasses used for config/models.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ - main package with adapters/, triggers/, knowledge/, evolution/ subpackages. tests/ - flat test files. dashboard/ - frontend (DO NOT TOUCH).
